description: YHCoat-2060 is a one-component waterproofing coating formulated with a highly active polymer emulsion as its primary film-forming agent.
whereToUse: Suitable for new construction and refurbishment projects with waterproof requirements
especially suitable for wet rooms, such as kitchens, bathrooms, pools, and other areas with high moisture exposure
advantages: The unique keyed finish enhances the bonding strength with tile system
Water-based, safe, environmentally friendly, and low VOC
Ready to use after opening the pail
